extracted.name: Crunchy Fried Shrimp
extracted.description: Delicious fried shrimp have just the right amount of crunch thanks to panko bread crumbs. They fry up in just minutes for an easy weeknight meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails left intact
1 cup vegetable oil for frying, or as needed
instruction_lines: Mix flour, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Beat eggs in a second medium bowl until frothy. Place bread crumbs in a third bowl.
Dredge shrimp in the flour mixture, then shake off excess.
Then press shrimp into bread crumbs, turning to coat both sides.

Heat 2 inches oil in a large, heavy pot to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Deep-fry shrimp in batches in the hot oil until cooked through, about 1 minute. Use tongs to transfer shrimp to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Repeat to cook remaining shrimp.
Arrange shrimp on a platter to serve.
